sanskrit: itaś cāmutaś cāvataṃ yame iva yatamāne yad aitam | pra vāṃ bharan mānuṣī devayanta ||
english: From here and from there protect us, O you two who strive like the Yamas when you come; a mortal woman longing for the gods brings offerings forward to you both.

sanskrit: ā sīdataṃ svam ulokaṃ vidāne svāsasthe bhavatam indave naḥ | yuje vāṃ brahma pūrvyaṃ namobhir vi śloka eti pathyeva sūreḥ ||
english: Take your seat in your own world, knowing it; be a good dwelling-place for us, O Indu. I yoke the ancient sacred word for you both with reverences; the hymn goes forth like the sun's own path.

sanskrit: śṛṇvantu viśve amṛtasya putrā ā ye dhāmāni divyāni tasthuḥ | trīṇi padāni rupo anv arohaṃ catuṣpadīm anv emi vratena ||
english: Let all the sons of immortality hear — those who have taken their stations in the divine realms. I ascended three steps of the ruddy one; I follow the four-footed (verse) by sacred vow.

sanskrit: akṣareṇa prati mima etām ṛtasya nābhāv adhi saṃ pūnāmi | devebhyaḥ kam avṛṇīta mṛtyuṃ prajāyai kam amṛtaṃ nāvṛṇīta ||
english: By the imperishable syllable I measure out this (offering); I purify it fully at the navel of cosmic order. For the gods Manu chose death; for offspring he did not choose immortality.

sanskrit: bṛhaspatiṃ yajñām̐ akṛṇvata rṣiṃ priyāṃ yamas tanvaṃ prā rirekha | tvam agna īḍito jātavedo avāḍ ḍhavyānī surabhīṇi kṛtvī | prādāḥ pitṛbhyaḥ svadhayā te akṣann addhi tvaṃ deva prayatā havīṃṣi ||
english: They made Bṛhaspati the seer of sacrifices; Yama relinquished his beloved body. You, O Agni, when invoked, O Jātavedas, carried the oblations forward having made them fragrant; you bestowed them on the Fathers with the ancestral offering — they ate. Now eat, O god, the oblations duly presented.

sanskrit: āsīnāso aruṇīnām upasthe rayiṃ dhatta dāśuṣe martyāya | putrebhyaḥ pitaras tasya vasvaḥ pra yacchata ta ihorjaṃ dadhāta ||
english: You who sit in the lap of the ruddy (dawn) goddesses, bestow wealth upon the mortal who offers. Let the Fathers extend their goods to his sons; let them deposit vigor here.

sanskrit: agniṣvattāḥ pitara eha gacchata sadaḥsadaḥ sadata supraṇītayaḥ | attā havīṃṣi prayatāni barhiṣi rayiṃ ca naḥ sarvavīraṃ dadhāta ||
english: O Fathers tasted by Agni, come here; sit at seat after seat, well-led ones. Eat the oblations duly set out on the sacred grass, and bestow on us wealth abounding in all heroes.

sanskrit: upahūtāḥ pitaraḥ somyāso barhiṣv eṣu nidhiṣu priyeṣu | ta ā gamantu ta iha śruvantv adhi bruvantu te 'vantv asmān ||
english: The Soma-loving Fathers have been called upon, in these dear resting places on the sacred grass. Let them come here, let them hear here; let them speak their blessing and protect us.

sanskrit: ye naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ somyāso anūhire somapīthaṃ vasisthāḥ | tebhir yamaḥ saṃrarāṇo havīṃṣy uśann uśadbhiḥ pratikāmam attu ||
english: Those who are our Soma-loving Fathers of old, the very wealthy ones who passed on the Soma-drinking, with them Yama, well pleased and willing, along with the willing ones, may eat the oblations to his desire.

sanskrit: ye tātṛṣur devatrā jīhamānā hotrāvida stomataṣṭāso arkaiḥ | āgne yāhi suvidatryebhir arvāk satyaiḥ kavyaiḥ pitṛbhir gharmasadbhiḥ ||
english: Those who thirsted (for the divine), who strove godward, who knew the office of Hotṛ, who fashioned praises with hymns — come hither, O Agni, with those fathers who know things well, those truthful poets who sit at the gharma cauldron.

sanskrit: ye satyāso havirado haviṣyā indreṇa devaiḥ sarathaṃ dadhānāḥ | āgne yāhi sahasraṃ devavandaiḥ paraiḥ pūrvaiḥ pitṛbhir gharmasadbhiḥ ||
english: Those truthful ones, eaters of oblations, worthy of oblation, who keep company with Indra and the gods on the same chariot — come, O Agni, with a thousand praised by the gods, with both the latter and earlier Fathers who sit at the gharma cauldron.

sanskrit: upa sarpa mātaraṃ bhūmim etām uruvyacasaṃ pṛthivīṃ suśevām | ūrṇamradāḥ pṛthivī dakṣiṇāvata eṣā tvā pātu nirṛter upasthāt ||
english: Approach this mother, the earth, the broad-spreading, the kindly ground. May the earth, yielding wool-soft comfort, gracious with her right side, protect you from the lap of Nirṛti.

sanskrit: uc chvañcasva pṛthivi mā ni bādhathāḥ sūpāyanāsmai bhava sūpavañcanā | mātā putraṃ yathā sicā- -abhy enaṃ bhūma ūrṇuhi ||
english: Heave yourself up, O Earth; do not press down on him; be easy of access to him, easy to step aside for him. As a mother wraps her son in her garment-hem, so cover him over, O Earth.

sanskrit: ucchvañcamānā pṛthivī su tiṣṭhatu sahasraṃ mita upa hi śrayantām | te gṛhāso ghṛtaścutaḥ syonā viśvāhāsmai śaraṇāḥ santv atra ||
english: Let the upheaving earth stand firm; let a thousand measured pillars lean upon it. Let those houses dripping with ghee, those comfortable ones, be shelters for him here forever.

sanskrit: ut te stabhnāti pṛthivīṃ tvat pari- -imaṃ lokaṃ vidadhan mo aharṣam | etāṃ sthūṇāṃ pitaro dhārayantv atrā yamaḥ sadanā te kṛṇotu ||
english: I prop up the earth away from you, distributing this world; may I not have taken it away. Let the Fathers hold fast this pillar; let Yama make dwelling places for you here.

sanskrit: atharvā pūrṇaṃ camasaṃ yam indrāyābibhar vājinīvate | tasmin kṛṇotu sukṛtasya lokaṃ tasminn induḥ pavate viśvadānīm ||
english: The full cup which Atharvan carried for Indra the prize-possessing — in that let (Indra) create the world of the well-doer; in that the drop (Soma) is ever purified, giver of all.

sanskrit: amum agne camasaṃ mā vi jijñaraḥ priyo devānām upa somyānām | eṣa yaś camaso devapānas tasminn evā amṛtā mādayante ||
english: Do not shatter that cup, O Agni; be dear to the gods, the Soma-loving ones. That cup is the god-drinking cup; in it alone the immortals take their delight.

sanskrit: yat te kṛṣṇaḥ śakuna ātutoda pipīlaḥ sarpa uta vā śvāpadaḥ | agniṣ ṭad viśvād ā pṛṇātu vidvān somaś cā yo brāhmaṇām̐ āviveśa ||
english: Whatever a black bird has pecked at you, or an ant, a snake, or a beast of prey — may Agni the all-knowing fill that fully, and Soma who has entered the Brahmins.

sanskrit: payasvatīr oṣadhayaḥ payasvān māmakaṃ vacaḥ | atho payasvad yat payas tena mā saha jinvatha ||
english: Milk-bearing are the plants; milk-bearing is my speech. And that which has milk — with that milk, gladden me together with it.

sanskrit: imā narīty ekā ||
english: "These women" — thus one (verse).

sanskrit: saṃ gacchasva pitṛbhiḥ saṃ yamena- -iṣṭāpūrtena parame vyoman | hitvāvadyaṃ punar astam ehi saṃ gacchasva tanvā suvarcāḥ ||
english: Unite with the Fathers, unite with Yama, with what has been sacrificed and given, in the highest heaven. Abandoning blemish, come home again; unite with your body, O bright-rayed one.

sanskrit: ye agnidagdhā ye 'nagnidagdhā madhye divaḥ svadhayā mādayante | tebhyaḥ svarāḍ asunītim etāṃ yathāvaśaṃ tanvaṃ kalpayāti ||
english: Those cremated by fire and those not cremated by fire, who delight in the ancestral offering in the midst of heaven — for them may the self-ruling one (Yama) arrange this guidance of the vital breaths, shaping the body as he wills.

sanskrit: ā rabhasva jātavedas tejasvad dharo astu te | śarīram asya saṃ daha- -athainaṃ dhehi sukṛtām uloke ||
english: Seize hold, O Jātavedas; let your flame be radiant. Burn up this body fully, and then place him in the world of the well-doers.

sanskrit: punar dehi vanaspate ya eṣa nihitas tvayi | yathā yamasādana āsātai vidathā vadan ||
english: Give back, O Lord of the Forest, the one who has been placed in you, so that he may sit in Yama's dwelling, speaking wisdom in the assembly.

sanskrit: śaṃ te nihāro bhavatu śaṃ te pṛṣṭhāva śīyatām | śītike śītikāvaty ahlādake hlādakāvati | maṇḍūkyāpsu saṃ bhava imaṃ sv agniṃ śamaya ||
english: Auspicious to you may the mist be; auspiciously may the dew descend upon you. O cool one, O you who are full of coolness, O refreshing one, O you who are full of refreshment — O frog-herb, arise in the waters; quench well this fire.

sanskrit: vivasvān no 'bhayaṃ kṛṇotu paraitu mṛtyur amṛtaṃ na aitu | iha me vīrā bahavo bhavantv aśvāvad goman mayy astu puṣṭam ||
english: May Vivasvant make us free from fear; let death depart; let immortality come to us. Let many heroes be born here for me; let prosperity in horses and cattle rest in me.

sanskrit: vivasvān no 'mṛtatve dadhātu yaḥ sutrāmā jīradānuḥ sudānuḥ | imān rakṣaḥ puruṣān ā jarimṇo mo ṣv eṣām asavo yamaṃ guḥ ||
english: May Vivasvant place us in immortality — he who is a good protector, swift in giving, generous in giving. Protect these men from old age; let not their vital breaths go to Yama.

sanskrit: yo dadhre antarikṣeṇa mahnā pitṝṇāṃ kaviḥ pramatir matīnām | tam arcata viśvamitrā havirbhiḥ sa no yamaḥ prataraṃ jīvase dhāt ||
english: He who upholds (all things) by his greatness through the middle air, the seer of the Fathers, the highest wisdom of wisdoms — him do you Viśvamitras praise with oblations; may that Yama grant us a further span of life.

sanskrit: ā rohata divam uttamām ṛṣayo mā bibhītana | somapāḥ somapāyina idaṃ vaḥ kriyate havir aganma jyotir uttamam ||
english: Ascend to the highest heaven, O seers; do not be afraid. O Soma-drinkers, O you who are Soma-drinkers, this oblation is made for you; we have arrived at the highest light.

sanskrit: pra ketuna bṛhatā bhāty agnir ā rodasī vṛṣabho roravīti | divaś cid antām̐ upamām̐ ud ānaḍ apām upasthe mahiṣo vavardha ||
english: Agni shines forth with his great banner; the bull (of heaven) roars filling both worlds. He has pushed up to the very highest boundaries of heaven; the great buffalo has grown in the lap of the waters.

sanskrit: nāke suparṇam upa yat patantaṃ hṛdā venanto abhyacakṣata tvā | hiraṇyapakṣaṃ varuṇasya dūtaṃ yamasya yonau śakunaṃ bhuraṇyam ||
english: The eager ones looked upon you with the heart as you flew on the vault of heaven, O bird — golden-winged, messenger of Varuṇa, the swift bird in Yama's womb.

sanskrit: indra kratuṃ na ā bhara pitā putrebhyo yathā | śikṣā ṇo asmin puruhūta vājini jīvā jyotir aśīmahi ||
english: O Indra, bring us wisdom as a father brings it to his sons. Teach us in this prize-winning (battle), O much-invoked one; may we, alive, attain the living light.

sanskrit: ye te pūrva ity ekā ||
english: "Those former ones of yours" — thus one (verse).
